orig_text:
The user-id and password MUST NOT contain any control characters (see
   "CTL" in Appendix B.1 of [RFC5234]).
correct_text:
The user-id and password MUST NOT contain any ASCII-compatible control
   characters (see "CTL" in Appendix B.1 of [RFC5234]).
notes: The Original Text is misleading due to the language "any control characters", which could be interpreted as including certain ASCII-incompatible Unicode control characters (see this Wiki article: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unicode_control_characters). The text clearly intends to be specifying the scope by reference to "'CTL' in Appendix B.1 of [RFC5234]", but that source clearly specifies the range as being the subset of all control characters that happen to be ASCII-compatible. This erratum recognizes this distinction and thus proposes a Corrected Text which appropriately narrows the scope to only "ASCII-compatible control characters", thus aligning with the source reference to RFC5234.
